title: caltha palustris lusus crenata
intro: Caltha palustris lusus crenata, commonly known as Marsh Marigold, is a flowering plant that belongs to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). The Marsh Marigold is known for its bright yellow and white flowers, which are a rich source of various bioactive compounds that provide numerous health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can be used to treat various health conditions such as wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Marsh Marigold include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and health benefits.
